event: Lin lands in Bombay on a false passport.
notes: 1980s terminal is gone; the view is the approach road.
mapsQuery: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport Mumbai

place: India Guest House (now FabExpress Colaba Grand), Minoo Desai Rd
event: Lin meets Prabaker and checks into the India Guest House.
notes: Closed; the building is now Hotel Colaba Grand. Source: Karl Rock, 'The Real Locations of Shantaram' (blog.karlrock.com, 2022).
mapsQuery: FabExpress Colaba Grand Minoo Desai Road Colaba Mumbai

event: Karla pulls Lin back from an oncoming bus on the Causeway.
notes: Source: Karl Rock, 'The Real Locations of Shantaram' (blog.karlrock.com, 2022).

event: Lin meets Karla and the expat crowd at Leopold's.
notes: Still open; bullet holes from 2008 are on display. Source: Karl Rock, 'The Real Locations of Shantaram' (blog.karlrock.com, 2022); readtheplaces.com/shantaram.

place: Gateway of India → Radio Club sea wall
event: Lin and Karla's first walk, along the sea wall from the Gateway to the Radio Club.
notes: Source: Karl Rock, 'The Real Locations of Shantaram' (blog.karlrock.com, 2022). The Radio Club is at 18.9177, 72.8317.

event: The Taj overlooks the Gateway, at the heart of Lin's Colaba.
notes: Source: Karl Rock, 'The Real Locations of Shantaram' (blog.karlrock.com, 2022).

event: Lin comes to the Sassoon Dock area to eat and watch the fish trade.
notes: Source: Karl Rock, 'The Real Locations of Shantaram' (blog.karlrock.com, 2022). The dock itself is restricted; the view is the road outside the gate.

event: Lin and Prabaker set off inland toward the village.
notes: Which station they leave from is a guess.

event: Months in the village, where Prabaker's mother names Lin Shantaram.
notes: Roberts deliberately kept the real village anonymous; he said only that it was a Maharashtra village near Mumbai (Redorbit/AP 2006; Rediff 2004). The pin is a regional stand-in. Prabhakar Kisan Khare's family acknowledged knowing Roberts (Digital Spy).

event: Robbed and broke, Lin moves into the slum, survives a fire and opens a free clinic.
notes: Real: Roberts said he lived in the Cuffe Parade slum and ran a clinic there (Juhu Journal interview, 2005). The house and clinic are gone and the area is now concrete; Karl Rock puts the entrance near J-Walk Fitness Gym (Karl Rock, 'The Real Locations of Shantaram' (blog.karlrock.com, 2022)). Readtheplaces treats the slum as a composite.
mapsQuery: Cuffe Parade slum Ambedkar Nagar Mumbai

place: World Trade Centre: 'Village in the Sky'
event: A feast on the 35th-floor roof of the WTC building site, which the slum grew up beside to house its construction workers.
notes: The book says the slum began as housing for WTC construction workers (GradeSaver ch 9-12 summary). The WTC stands in Cuffe Parade.
mapsQuery: World Trade Centre Cuffe Parade Mumbai

place: Walk from the slum into Colaba (via Cuffe Parade Rd)
event: Lin's regular walk from the slum north into Colaba, toward the Causeway and Leopold's.
notes: The book doesn't give a street-by-street route. This is the obvious path along Cuffe Parade Road (Capt. Prakash Pethe Marg) toward Colaba; inferred, not sourced.

event: Lin meets the mafia don Abdel Khader Khan.
notes: Not identified; a rough Dongri pin. Standing Babas den: location unknown (Karl Rock blog comments), so it no longer has its own pin.

event: The Back Bay seafront, one of Lin's favourite stretches of the city.
notes: Named in the novel (readtheplaces.com/shantaram).

event: Haji Ali causeway: Roberts says gangsters crossed it to bathe and pray before a confrontation.
notes: CNN Talk Asia quote via Karl Rock, 'The Real Locations of Shantaram' (blog.karlrock.com, 2022). Scene detail needs checking against the book.

event: Lin is held in the Colaba lock-up.
notes: Across the road from Leopold's; Roberts says the lock-up section is true (Juhu Journal 2005; Karl Rock, 'The Real Locations of Shantaram' (blog.karlrock.com, 2022)).

event: Months in Arthur Road Jail, until Khaderbhai pays for his release.
notes: Mumbai Central Prison. Outside walls only, sensitive area (Karl Rock, 'The Real Locations of Shantaram' (blog.karlrock.com, 2022)).

event: Lin works as a Bollywood extra.
notes: Inside the studio there's no Google street coverage.

event: Lin and Karla escape to Goa.
notes: The beach isn't named; the street view is a representative Anjuna village road.

event: The group heads to Pakistan.
notes: No Google Street View in Pakistan.

event: They stage in Quetta before the border.
notes: No coverage.

event: Into Afghanistan with the mujahideen. Khaderbhai is killed in the mountains.
notes: No Google Street View in Afghanistan.

event: Lin returns to Bombay and the Colaba life.
notes: Source: Karl Rock, 'The Real Locations of Shantaram' (blog.karlrock.com, 2022).
